headline: Santander's AI lab uses Nvidia to evaluate models for banking tasks
body: Santander’s AI lab has teamed with Nvidia on capabilities for evaluating AI models and agents for banking. Its “Model Arena” evaluates open-weight models against banking tasks. In one experimental customer-service use case, the companies say a more efficient model lowered costs by more than 50%.
note: The bank says it is moving from large general-purpose models toward smaller, specialised ones. The cost figure comes from one experimental use case and is the companies' own claim.

evidence.text: Santander has teamed with Nvidia to come up with capabilities for evaluating artificial intelligence models and agents for banking.

“As part of this effort, Santander has been progressively moving from large general-purpose models towards smaller, specialised models designed for specific banking tasks,” Santander said in a news release provided to PYMNTS.
With the AI lab, Santander has constructed its “Model Arena” to evaluate open-weight models against banking tasks and determine which model is right for each workload.
The companies say their partnership is already bearing fruit.
In one experimental customer-service use case, Santander improved conversation quality while lowering costs by more than 50% by deploying a more efficient AI model.
